Hamta Pass and Chandratal Trek

Manali — Jobra — Chika — Balu Ka Ghera — Hampta Pass — Shea Goru — Chatru — Chandratal — Manali

About This Trip

Experience one of the most dramatic crossover treks in the Indian Himalayas—the breathtaking Hamta Pass & Chandratal Trek with Awara Banjara. This adventure takes you from the lush green valleys of Kullu to the stark, desert-like landscapes of Spiti, offering a complete Himalayan transformation in just a few days. Starting from Manali, trek through thick pine forests, flower-filled meadows, glacier streams, and tower over the landscape at Hamta Pass (14,100 ft) before concluding at the magical crescent-shaped Chandratal Lake.
